pr_title: roachtest: optimize cluster destroy and create
pr_body:
Currently, roachtest creates a cluster for running tests. Once the test is complete, it tries to reuse the cluster for the next test. Incase case the cluster cannot be reused for the next test, it destroys and creates a new cluster. This happens in sequence today.
cluster destory takes around a minute or two and the same is with cluster create. So, overall, this operation takes away ~4 minutes of the roachtest time.
If we run destroy in a goroutine and start the cluster create for the next test, we should be able to save 2 minutes.

Considering a teamcity nightly run, we see that we create/destroy ~20 clusters in a worker, which accounts to 2*20 = 40 minutes!!

Fixes: #125228
Epic: None
